node.title: Flow — board asks 'what did the AI spend buy?'
node.summary: The reporting flow where Maya must answer the board on AI spend with evidence, spanning Copilot/Cursor/Claude Code spend, delivery dashboards, surveys, and a spreadsheet.
node.interview_question: Walk me through this flow the way Maya lives it — where exactly does today's tooling leave her without an answer?

competitor.name: CloudZero
competitor.positioning: CloudZero's survey says 87% of finance leaders need to tie AI spend to results and only 22% can — but CloudZero sells the spend side and stops at 'a chart, not a chargeback.'
